subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt/land the open fork cleanup PR, replace it with a narrow current-main PR, or reject that cleanup direction?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open fork PR already owns the implementation attempt and needs human review/refresh/proof before this issue can be closed or a replacement queued.

options.title: Review or replace the fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers either land the existing candidate after refresh/proof or open a narrow replacement that preserves the same Google Chat lifecycle fix.

options.title: Reject the cleanup direction
options.body: Close the candidate PR and leave a maintainer rationale only if the product intentionally wants reaction-only Google Chat turns to leave no placeholder cleanup path.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers either land the existing candidate after refresh/proof or open a narrow replacement that preserves the same Google Chat lifecycle fix.
